property_summary: After a single fallback call with exactly 1 ether, the reference contract reverts (require(msg.value == 10 ether) fails) and leaves pastBlockTime unchanged (0), while the buggy contract (require(msg.value < 10 ether)) accepts the call and sets pastBlockTime to the current block.timestamp.
change_summary: Change the require condition from msg.value == 10 ether to msg.value < 10 ether, so the function can revert differently.
